description: Back arrows on Plan/Review/Escalation navigate to list page, skipping mission overview. Should navigate to mission overview (parent in zoom hierarchy). Sources: info-architecture R3.

title: ADR: Use Electron over Tauri for desktop shell
body: Record architecture decision: chose Electron over Tauri because WebKit on macOS causes production-breaking bugs (SVG shadows, audio glitching, WebKitGTK lacking WebRTC on Linux). Electron bundles Chromium giving consistent rendering. Acceptance: ADR doc created in docs/adr/ explaining tradeoffs.

title: ADR: Node.js/TypeScript backend over Rust
body: Record architecture decision: chose Node.js+TypeScript for apps/server over Rust because team is TypeScript-first, Rust doubles toolchain complexity (Cargo+npm), and mission-control's backend needs (process spawning, WebSocket, SQLite) are well-served by Node. Acceptance: ADR doc in docs/adr/.

title: ADR: Build on mission-control shell vs forking t3code or vibe-kanban
body: Record architecture decision: build on mission-control's existing shell rather than forking t3code (Effect lock-in) or vibe-kanban (Rust backend). Selectively extract wsTransport.ts + keybindings.ts from t3code, DiffViewer from vibe-kanban. Acceptance: ADR doc in docs/adr/ with comparison table.

title: ADR: Electron over pure web app for local agent tool
body: Record architecture decision: mission-control is a local-first tool (spawns agent processes, accesses filesystem, manages PTYs) so a desktop app shell is appropriate over a purely hosted web app. Acceptance: ADR doc in docs/adr/.

title: Scaffold apps/server Node.js/TypeScript package
body: Create apps/server package in the monorepo. Set up: package.json with name @repo/server, TypeScript config extending root tsconfig, src/index.ts entry point, nodemon or tsx for dev, basic Express or Hono HTTP server stub, vitest config. Add to npm workspaces. No functionality yet — just the scaffold that builds and starts. Acceptance: npm run dev in apps/server starts without errors.

title: Scaffold apps/desktop Electron package
body: Create apps/desktop Electron package. Set up: package.json with electron dependency, main process entry (src/main.ts), preload script stub, renderer loads apps/web dev server in development or built assets in production, electron-builder config for macOS/Windows/Linux. Add to npm workspaces. Acceptance: npm run dev in apps/desktop opens an Electron window showing the web app.

title: Create packages/transport for shared WebSocket protocol code
body: Create packages/transport package. Will hold: WS message type definitions (Zod schemas), wsTransport client class (ported from t3code), shared request/response/push channel types. Depends on packages/shared. Acceptance: package builds, can be imported by apps/web and apps/server.

title: Set up SQLite database in apps/server with better-sqlite3
body: Add better-sqlite3 (synchronous SQLite) to apps/server. Create src/db/database.ts with connection setup, WAL mode, foreign keys enabled. Create src/db/migrate.ts for running ordered migrations from src/db/migrations/. Acceptance: database initializes on server start, migrations run in order.

title: Configure Turborepo pipeline for apps/server and apps/desktop
body: Update turbo.json to include apps/server (build, dev, test tasks) and apps/desktop (build, dev tasks) in the pipeline. Ensure correct dependency ordering: server builds before desktop, web builds before desktop. Acceptance: turbo run build completes for all packages including new ones.

title: Create missions table migration
body: Create 001_missions.sql migration. Schema: id (text PK), title, goal, scope, stage (enum), risk_tier, priority, status, created_at, updated_at, blocked_by (JSON array of IDs), blocks (JSON array of IDs), workflow_id, tags (JSON). Acceptance: migration runs, table created with correct schema.

title: Add dependency-cruiser rules for new packages
body: Extend .dependency-cruiser.cjs (or equivalent) to enforce inward-only dependency flow for apps/server and packages/transport. apps/server may import packages/transport and packages/shared. packages/transport may only import packages/shared. Acceptance: npm run dep-check passes with new rules.

title: Create agent_sessions table migration
body: Create 002_agent_sessions.sql migration. Schema: id (text PK), mission_id (FK), executor (enum: claude-code, codex, etc), status (idle/planning/executing/waiting-approval/error/completed), working_dir, branch, created_at, updated_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Set up ESLint + TypeScript strict config for apps/server
body: Configure ESLint and strict TypeScript for apps/server. Extend the root tsconfig. Enable strict mode, no-any, consistent-type-imports. Set up path aliases matching packages/shared and packages/transport. Acceptance: npm run lint and tsc --noEmit pass in apps/server.

title: Create domain events table migration (event store)
body: Create 003_events.sql migration for append-only event store. Schema: id (text PK), aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload (JSON), sequence_number (integer), occurred_at. Index on (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, sequence_number). Acceptance: migration runs, append-only by convention.

title: Create evidence table migration
body: Create 004_evidence.sql migration. Schema: id, mission_id (FK), type (test-result/screenshot/log/artifact/ci-result), title, content/url, status (pending/verified/failed), submitted_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Port wsTransport.ts from t3code to packages/transport
body: Read t3code's apps/web/src/wsTransport.ts (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) and port it to packages/transport/src/WsTransport.ts. Remove all Effect dependencies. Replace with plain TypeScript. Keep: reconnection with exponential backoff (500ms-8s), message queuing during disconnect, typed channel subscriptions, request/response correlation with timeouts. Use Zod for message validation instead of Effect Schema. Acceptance: unit tests pass, no Effect imports.

title: Create approvals table migration
body: Create 005_approvals.sql migration. Schema: id, agent_session_id (FK), mission_id (FK), request_type (tool-use/file-write/command/other), request_payload (JSON), status (pending/approved/rejected), decided_by, decided_at, created_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Define WebSocket protocol message types with Zod
body: In packages/transport/src/protocol.ts, define the full WS protocol using Zod schemas. Include: BaseRequest (id, type, body), BaseResponse (id, type, result/error), PushEvent (channel, event, payload). Define initial message types: ping/pong, mission.list, mission.get, mission.stageTransition, agent.status, agent.chat.message, agent.approval.request, agent.approval.response. Acceptance: all types exported, validated with Zod, TypeScript types inferred correctly.

title: Create mission_events table migration for audit log
body: Create 006_mission_events.sql migration. Schema: id, mission_id (FK), event_type (stage-changed/agent-started/agent-stopped/approval-requested/approved/rejected/evidence-added/escalation-raised/escalation-resolved), actor, payload (JSON), occurred_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Implement WebSocket server handler in apps/server
body: Create apps/server/src/ws/WsServer.ts. Use the 'ws' npm package. Handle: client connection/disconnection, message routing to registered handlers, push event broadcast to subscribed clients, request/response correlation matching client's WsTransport. Register handlers for initial message types defined in protocol. Acceptance: server handles connect/disconnect, routes messages, broadcasts pushes.

title: Define mission command types
body: In apps/server/src/domain/commands.ts, define Zod schemas for all mission commands: CreateMission, UpdateMissionStage, AddEvidence, RequestApproval, ResolveApproval, RaiseEscalation, ResolveEscalation, AssignAgent, CompleteAgent. Each command has: id, type, payload, issued_at, issued_by. Acceptance: all types compile, Zod validated.

title: Create useWebSocket React hook in apps/web
body: Create apps/web/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts wrapping WsTransport from packages/transport. Provides: connection status, send(request), subscribe(channel, handler), automatic reconnection. Expose via React context (WsContext) so all components share one connection. Acceptance: hook connects to local server, ConnectionStatusBanner shows real state.

title: Define mission domain event types
body: In apps/server/src/domain/events.ts, define Zod schemas for domain events emitted by the mission aggregate: MissionCreated, StageChanged, AgentSessionStarted, AgentSessionCompleted, ApprovalRequested, ApprovalResolved, EvidenceAdded, EscalationRaised, EscalationResolved. Acceptance: all events compile, Zod validated.

title: Implement agent output streaming via WebSocket
body: Wire agent PTY output -> WS push events. Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentSession.ts that manages a running agent: buffers output, emits agent.chat.message WS push events with streaming chunks, tracks agent status transitions (planning/executing/waiting-approval/completed/error). Acceptance: frontend receives streaming output in real time. [type=feature]

title: Wire ConnectionStatusBanner to real WebSocket state
body: ConnectionStatusBanner currently always shows connected. Wire it to the real useWebSocket hook state: connected/connecting/disconnected/error. Show appropriate message and reconnect button when disconnected. Acceptance: banner accurately reflects WS connection state in all scenarios.

title: Implement mission Decider (command validation -> event emission)
body: Create apps/server/src/domain/decider.ts. The Decider takes (current state, command) and returns (events[] | error). Enforce invariants: can only transition stages in valid order (plan->execute->review->escalation->completed), can only approve when approval is pending, etc. Pure function - no side effects, no DB calls. Acceptance: unit tests cover all valid and invalid command/state combinations.

title: Implement agent pause/resume/stop controls
body: Add WS message handlers: agent.pause (send SIGSTOP to PTY), agent.resume (send SIGCONT), agent.stop (send SIGTERM then SIGKILL after timeout), agent.sendMessage (pipe text to PTY stdin). Wire to AgentChatPanel play/pause/reset controls. Acceptance: controls affect running agent process. [type=feature]

title: Implement mission Projector (events -> read model)
body: Create apps/server/src/domain/projector.ts. The Projector folds a sequence of events into a Mission read model. For each event type, update the relevant fields. The Projector is a pure reducer: (state, event) => state. Acceptance: unit tests verify correct state after sequences of events.

title: Implement agent session persistence and recovery
body: When server restarts, restore agent session state from DB. For sessions that were running: mark as interrupted, allow user to resume or start fresh. Store agent session metadata in agent_sessions table. Acceptance: server restart doesn't silently lose session state. [type=task]

title: Implement multi-agent session support per mission
body: A mission can have multiple agent sessions (e.g. parallel subagents). Create AgentSessionManager that tracks all sessions for a mission, assigns session IDs, routes WS messages to correct session. Acceptance: two concurrent agent sessions on same mission work independently. [type=feature]

title: Implement event store (append + replay)
body: Create apps/server/src/infra/EventStore.ts. Methods: append(aggregateId, events[]), loadEvents(aggregateId) -> events[], loadAllEvents() -> events[]. Uses the domain_events SQLite table. Sequences events per aggregate. Acceptance: events persist across server restarts, replay reconstructs correct state.

title: Implement approval gate in agent session
body: When an agent requests a dangerous action (detected by parsing agent output for permission prompts), pause the agent and emit an agent.approval.request WS push event. The agent session enters waiting-approval state. Resume only after approval/rejection received. Create apps/server/src/agents/ApprovalGate.ts. Acceptance: agent halts on permission request, resumes after decision. [type=feature]

title: Implement mission repository using event sourcing
body: Create apps/server/src/infra/MissionRepository.ts. Uses EventStore to load/save missions. load(id): replays events through Projector to get current state. save(id, command): runs Decider, appends resulting events, publishes WS push events. Acceptance: missions survive server restarts, stage transitions are recorded as events.

title: Implement approval request/response WS handlers
body: Add WS message handlers: agent.approval.respond with {sessionId, approvalId, decision: 'approved'|'rejected', note?}. Store decision in approvals table. Emit agent.approval.resolved push event. Acceptance: frontend can send approval decisions, agent resumes or stops accordingly. [type=task]

title: Implement GET /api/missions endpoint
body: In apps/server/src/routes/missions.ts, implement GET /api/missions. Returns array of mission read models (projected from event store). Support query params: stage filter, workflow_id filter. Acceptance: returns correct JSON, 200 status.

title: Implement POST /api/missions endpoint
body: Implement POST /api/missions. Accepts CreateMission command body. Runs through Decider, persists events, returns created mission. Validate with Zod. Return 201 with created mission. Acceptance: mission persists, appears in GET /api/missions.

title: Wire PermissionGate component to real approval state
body: PermissionGate.tsx currently has no real data. Wire it to the WS agent.approval.request events. Show the pending approval (what the agent wants to do), provide approve/reject controls. Pipe decision back via WS. Acceptance: real approval requests appear in UI, user decisions reach the agent. [type=task]

title: Implement GET /api/missions/:id endpoint
body: Implement GET /api/missions/:id. Loads mission from event store, projects to read model. Returns 404 if not found. Acceptance: returns correct mission data.

title: Wire DecisionBar component to real approval state
body: DecisionBar.tsx in review/execute pages should show when an agent approval is pending. Wire to WS state. Highlight when action required. Acceptance: DecisionBar shows pending approvals with context. [type=task]

title: Create WsContext React provider in apps/web
body: Create apps/web/src/contexts/WsContext.tsx. Wraps the WsTransport from packages/transport. Provides: connection status, typed send(), typed subscribe(channel). Wrap AppShell with WsProvider so all pages share one connection. Acceptance: all pages can access WS connection via useWs() hook.

title: Implement PATCH /api/missions/:id/stage endpoint
body: Implement PATCH /api/missions/:id/stage. Accepts {stage: Stage} body. Runs UpdateMissionStage command through Decider. Enforces valid stage transitions. Returns updated mission or 422 with error on invalid transition. Broadcasts StageChanged WS push event. Acceptance: valid transitions succeed, invalid ones return 422.

title: Implement approval audit trail
body: All approval decisions (approved/rejected, who, when, what was requested) are written to the approvals table. Expose GET /api/missions/:id/approvals endpoint. Acceptance: approval history is queryable per mission. [type=task]

title: Create mission store with Zustand replacing data/missions.ts
body: Create apps/web/src/store/missionStore.ts using Zustand. Initial load from GET /api/missions. Subscribe to mission.stageChanged, mission.created, mission.updated WS push channels for real-time updates. Expose: missions, getMission(id), actions. Gradually replace data/missions.ts imports. Acceptance: mission list page shows real missions from server.

title: Research Claude Code CLI spawn protocol
body: Investigate how to spawn Claude Code (claude CLI) as a child process: what args/flags trigger agent mode, what output format it uses (JSON lines? streaming?), how to send follow-up messages, how to detect completion vs waiting-for-input. Document findings in docs/research/claude-code-protocol.md. Acceptance: document describes spawn command, output format, input protocol, completion signals.

title: Add simple-git to apps/server and initialize git service
body: Add simple-git dependency to apps/server. Create apps/server/src/git/GitService.ts with methods: getCurrentBranch(repoPath), getCommitHistory(repoPath, limit), getDiff(repoPath, fromRef, toRef), getStatus(repoPath). Acceptance: service returns real git data for a test repo. [type=task]

title: Create agent session store replacing data/agent-sessions.ts
body: Create apps/web/src/store/agentSessionStore.ts using Zustand. Subscribe to agent.status WS push channel. Tracks: session status, current step, steps history, output buffer. Replace data/agent-sessions.ts imports. Acceptance: AgentSwimlane shows real agent status.

title: Research MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration options
body: Investigate MCP as an alternative/complement to CLI spawning: what MCP servers exist for code execution, what the protocol looks like for agent communication, whether Claude Code exposes an MCP server, how MCP compares to direct CLI spawning for our use case. Document in docs/research/mcp-options.md. Acceptance: recommendation on whether to use MCP or CLI for initial integration.

title: Implement git checkpoint (commit per agent turn)
body: After each agent turn completes, automatically commit staged changes as a checkpoint: git add -A && git commit -m 'checkpoint: [mission-id] turn [n]'. Store checkpoint commit SHA in agent_sessions table. Create apps/server/src/git/Checkpointing.ts. Acceptance: each turn creates a recoverable git commit. [type=feature]

title: Add TanStack Query for REST data fetching
body: Add @tanstack/react-query to apps/web. Set up QueryClient in App.tsx. Create query hooks: useMissions(), useMission(id), useMissionEvidence(id), useMissionApprovals(id), useWorkflows(). These complement the WS real-time updates. Acceptance: pages can use query hooks, data loads and caches correctly.

title: Implement agent process spawning with node-pty
body: Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentSpawner.ts. Spawns an agent process (Claude Code CLI or similar) via node-pty for PTY support. Handles: spawn with working directory + env vars, output streaming to caller, input piping, process lifecycle (running/completed/failed/killed). Acceptance: can spawn a process, stream its output, and detect completion.

title: Implement rollback to git checkpoint
body: Add WS handler: mission.rollback {sessionId, checkpointSha}. Runs git reset --hard {checkpointSha} in the agent's working directory. Updates session state. Broadcasts mission.rolledBack push event. Acceptance: UI rollback action reverts code to checkpoint. [type=feature]

title: Replace mock chat data with WebSocket-backed stream
body: AgentChatPanel currently uses CANNED_RESPONSES from data/agent-chat.ts. Replace with real WS subscription to agent.chat.message channel for the current session. Messages stream in as the agent produces output. Acceptance: chat panel shows real agent output, streaming.

title: Implement diff generation for review stage
body: When a mission enters review stage, generate a diff between the mission's base branch and current branch. Create apps/server/src/git/DiffGenerator.ts: getDiffForReview(repoPath, baseBranch, currentBranch) -> file-level diffs with hunks. Expose as GET /api/missions/:id/diff. Acceptance: returns structured diff data suitable for DiffViewer component. [type=task]

title: Wire MissionHome page to real mission data
body: MissionHome (mission list) currently uses mock data. Wire to useMissions() query hook. Real missions appear in the list. Filtering by stage works. Mission cards show real data (goal, stage, risk tier, priority). Acceptance: real missions from server appear in home page.

title: Implement evidence submission API
body: Add POST /api/missions/:id/evidence endpoint. Accepts: type (test-result/screenshot/log/artifact/ci-result), title, content or file upload. Stores in evidence table. Broadcasts evidence.added WS push event. Acceptance: evidence can be submitted, appears in EvidenceRail. [type=feature]

title: Wire MissionDetail page to real mission data
body: MissionDetail shows mission metadata. Wire to useMission(id) hook. Display real: title, goal, scope, risks, acceptance criteria, stage, risk tier, created date, workflow. Acceptance: real mission detail loads correctly.

title: Wire EvidenceRail component to real evidence data
body: EvidenceRail currently shows mock data from data/evidence.ts. Wire to GET /api/missions/:id/evidence. Update on evidence.added WS events. Acceptance: real submitted evidence appears in EvidenceRail. [type=task]

title: Wire MissionPlan page to real data and enable editing
body: MissionPlan page shows plan-stage information. Wire to real mission data. Enable inline editing of: goal, scope, acceptance criteria, risks. Save via PATCH /api/missions/:id. Acceptance: plan edits persist to server.

title: Implement verification state computation from real evidence
body: computeVerificationState() currently works on mock data. Wire it to real evidence items from the API. Compute verification state (unverified/partial/verified/failed) based on evidence types and statuses. Acceptance: verification badge on MissionReview reflects real evidence state. [type=task]

title: Wire AgentChatPanel to real agent WS stream
body: AgentChatPanel must show real streaming agent output. Subscribe to agent.chat.message WS channel for current session. Handle message types: text, tool-use, tool-result, thinking, error. Render each type appropriately. Acceptance: real Claude output appears in chat panel with correct formatting.

title: Add xterm.js and replace TerminalEmulator stub
body: Add xterm.js and xterm-addon-fit, xterm-addon-attach to apps/web. Replace the 92-line mock TerminalEmulator.tsx with a real xterm.js terminal. Handle: resize, scrollback, ANSI codes, clipboard. Acceptance: xterm.js renders in the terminal pane, handles ANSI color codes correctly.

title: Implement CI/test result ingestion
body: Create a webhook endpoint POST /api/webhooks/ci that accepts CI results (test pass/fail, coverage %) from GitHub Actions or similar. Automatically creates evidence items. Acceptance: CI results appear as evidence without manual submission. [type=feature]

title: Wire AgentSwimlane to real agent status
body: AgentSwimlane shows agent status and step history. Subscribe to agent.status WS channel. Show: current status (planning/executing/waiting/completed), steps list with timestamps, current step highlighted. Acceptance: swimlane reflects real agent state in real time.

title: Implement PTY session management in apps/server
body: Create apps/server/src/terminal/PtyManager.ts using node-pty. Supports: create terminal session (spawn shell or specific command), stream PTY output to WS, pipe WS input to PTY stdin, handle resize (cols x rows), destroy session on disconnect. Acceptance: real shell accessible via PTY over WebSocket.

title: Track token usage per agent session
body: Parse agent output for token usage data (Claude outputs token counts). Store in a session_costs table: session_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, model, cost_usd, recorded_at. Acceptance: token usage accumulates per session. [type=feature]

title: Wire AgentConfigPanel to real agent config and controls
body: AgentConfigPanel shows agent configuration and start/stop controls. Wire to: GET agent config, start/stop/pause controls dispatch WS messages to server, executor dropdown (Claude Code, etc). Acceptance: can configure and start an agent from the UI.

title: Wire TerminalSessionPane to real PTY over WebSocket
body: TerminalSessionPane is a stub. Wire it to real PTY sessions via WS: on mount subscribe to terminal.output channel for session ID, pipe input events to terminal.input WS message, handle terminal.resize on resize. xterm.js renders the output. Acceptance: real terminal output from agent process appears in TerminalSessionPane.

title: Implement cost aggregation API
body: Add GET /api/costs endpoint with filters: by mission, by workflow, by date range. Returns aggregated input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd. Acceptance: CostDashboard can fetch real cost data. [type=task]

title: Wire start-agent flow from MissionExecute page
body: MissionExecute page needs a 'Start Agent' action that: selects working directory, selects executor, dispatches agent.start WS command to server. Server spawns agent process. Session ID returned and stored. Acceptance: clicking Start Agent spawns a real Claude Code process.

title: Handle terminal session lifecycle (create/destroy)
body: When an agent session starts, automatically create a PTY terminal session linked to it. Broadcast terminal.session.created push event with session ID. On agent completion, broadcast terminal.session.closed. Frontend auto-connects TerminalSessionPane. Acceptance: terminal appears automatically when agent runs.

title: Wire CostDashboard page to real cost data
body: CostDashboard.tsx currently shows hardcoded values. Replace with real data from GET /api/costs. Show cost by mission, trend over time. Acceptance: real token costs appear in CostDashboard. [type=task]

title: Wire LivePreview pane to real preview URL
body: LivePreview.tsx stub should show a running dev server preview. When agent starts a dev server, it broadcasts a preview.url.detected push event with the URL. Embed the URL in an iframe in LivePreview. Show placeholder when no preview running. Acceptance: auto-detected dev server URLs appear in LivePreview.

title: Implement Electron main process with server lifecycle
body: apps/desktop/src/main.ts: On app start, spawn apps/server as a child process (or fork). Wait for server to be ready (HTTP health check). Create BrowserWindow loading http://localhost:{port}. On app quit, gracefully shutdown server. Acceptance: opening Electron app starts server, closing it stops server cleanly.

title: Implement workflow execution state machine
body: Workflows group related missions with execution ordering. Create apps/server/src/workflows/WorkflowEngine.ts: tracks which missions in a workflow are complete, automatically unblocks dependent missions when blockers complete. Broadcasts workflow.missionUnblocked push events. Acceptance: completing mission A automatically makes blocked mission B available. [type=feature]

title: Extract DiffViewer from vibe-kanban and add to apps/web
body: Read vibe-kanban's diff viewer implementation (uses @git-diff-view/react). Create apps/web/src/components/review/DiffViewer.tsx wrapping @git-diff-view/react. Match mission-control's design tokens (dark theme, typography). Replace the mock DiffByIntent component. Acceptance: component renders unified and split diffs with syntax highlighting.

title: Set up Electron BrowserWindow with correct security settings
body: Configure BrowserWindow: contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, webSecurity: true. Set up preload script for any required IPC. Set correct CSP headers. Set window size/minSize appropriate for mission-control layout. Acceptance: app loads without security warnings, correct window size.

title: Wire Workflows page to real workflow data
body: Workflows page and WorkflowDetail currently show mock data. Wire to GET /api/workflows and GET /api/workflows/:id endpoints. Show real mission dependencies and completion state. Acceptance: real workflows appear in Workflows page. [type=task]

title: Wire MissionReview DiffViewer to real git diff data
body: MissionReview page shows the code diff for review. Wire to GET /api/missions/:id/diff. Pass diff data to DiffViewer component. Show per-file diffs, expandable, with line numbers. Acceptance: real code changes from agent appear in review diff.

title: Implement system tray icon with quick actions
body: Add Electron Tray with mission-control icon. Menu items: Show Window, Current Mission (if active), Quit. Show badge on tray icon when agent awaiting approval. Acceptance: tray icon appears, menu actions work, approval badge shows.

title: Wire MissionReview approve/reject to real API
body: MissionReview has approve/reject buttons. Wire to: POST /api/missions/:id/approve or /reject. On approval, transition mission to completed. On rejection, allow restart from execute stage. Broadcast stage change WS event. Acceptance: review decisions persist and trigger stage transitions.

title: Set up electron-builder for macOS distribution
body: Configure electron-builder in apps/desktop/package.json for macOS: DMG installer, code signing setup (even if ad-hoc for now), app icon (icns), bundle identifier com.missioncontrol.app, category developer tools. Add build:mac npm script. Acceptance: npm run build:mac produces a working .dmg.

title: Set up electron-builder for Windows distribution
body: Configure electron-builder for Windows: NSIS installer, app icon (ico), build:win script. Acceptance: npm run build:win produces a working installer.

title: Wire MissionEscalation page to real escalation data
body: MissionEscalation page is a static form. Wire to real escalation: load escalation context (why escalated, what agent was doing), allow human to: provide guidance and continue, reassign agent, abort mission. Dispatch appropriate commands. Acceptance: escalation resolution actions actually affect agent/mission state.

title: Set up electron-builder for Linux distribution
body: Configure electron-builder for Linux: AppImage target, build:linux script. Acceptance: npm run build:linux produces a working AppImage.

title: Implement activity log API for mission history
body: Add GET /api/missions/:id/history endpoint. Returns ordered list of mission_events from the audit table: stage changes, agent starts/stops, approvals, evidence added, escalations. Acceptance: history endpoint returns real activity.

title: Implement auto-updater with electron-updater
body: Add electron-updater to apps/desktop. Configure update feed URL. Check for updates on startup, show update notification in UI, download and install. Acceptance: update check runs on launch, notification appears when update available.

title: Wire History page to real mission history data
body: History page is a stub. Wire to GET /api/missions/:id/history (or global /api/history). Show activity feed: event type, actor, timestamp, payload summary. Acceptance: real mission history appears in History page.

title: Add deep link handler for mission:// protocol
body: Register mission:// URL scheme in electron-builder config. Handle in main process: mission://missions/{id} opens mission detail. Acceptance: clicking a mission:// link opens the app to the correct mission.

title: Port keybindings engine from t3code
body: Read t3code's apps/web/src/keybindings.ts and port to apps/web/src/lib/keybindings.ts. Remove Effect dependencies. Keep: conditional when clauses (context-aware shortcuts), platform normalization (Cmd vs Ctrl), key chord support, formatted display strings. Use plain TypeScript. Acceptance: keybinding engine works without Effect, unit tests pass.

title: Wire keybindings engine to AppShell
body: CLOSED: Keybindings engine port from t3code (bead-0089) was killed. This dependent ticket is moot. If keyboard shortcuts are needed, use tinykeys or plain keydown listeners on specific components. No dedicated engine needed.

title: Show keybindings in CommandPalette
body: CommandPalette should display the keyboard shortcut next to each action (like VS Code). Wire to keybindings engine to get the formatted shortcut string for each registered command. Acceptance: shortcuts appear in palette items, platform-normalized (cmd on Mac, Ctrl on Windows).

title: Implement browser session screenshot streaming
body: When agent uses a browser tool (Playwright/Puppeteer), capture screenshots and stream to BrowserSessionPane. Create apps/server/src/browser/BrowserCapture.ts: on screenshot event, encode as base64, broadcast browser.screenshot WS push event with session ID. BrowserSessionPane subscribes and displays. Acceptance: browser screenshots appear in real time during agent browser use.

title: Write unit tests for mission Decider
body: Comprehensive unit tests for apps/server/src/domain/decider.ts. Cover: all valid stage transitions, all invalid transitions (expect errors), approval command on non-pending state, escalation from valid states. Use Vitest. Acceptance: 100% branch coverage of Decider logic.

title: Write unit tests for mission Projector
body: Unit tests for apps/server/src/domain/projector.ts. Cover: empty event sequence gives initial state, each event type correctly updates state, full mission lifecycle sequence produces correct final state. Acceptance: all projection paths tested.

title: Write integration tests for WS protocol
body: Integration tests for the WebSocket server. Use a test WS client to: connect, send typed requests, receive responses, subscribe to push channels. Test: mission CRUD over WS, approval request/response round trip, agent status push events. Acceptance: protocol contract tested end-to-end.

title: Write E2E test: start agent, approve action, complete mission
body: Playwright E2E test that: opens mission-control, creates a mission, starts agent, receives approval request, approves it, verifies mission progresses. Uses a mock agent that emits scripted events. Acceptance: E2E test passes in CI.

title: Write E2E test: full mission lifecycle plan->execute->review->complete
body: Playwright E2E test covering the full mission lifecycle: create mission, move to plan stage, move to execute, start agent, complete agent turn, move to review, approve, move to completed. Verify stage transitions, evidence, correct page renders at each stage. Acceptance: E2E test passes in CI.

title: Wire CommandPalette actions to real navigation and commands
body: CommandPalette currently has navigation items. Ensure all items work: navigate to missions, open specific mission, create mission (opens form), filter missions by stage, navigate to workflows. Wire new items: start agent on current mission, approve pending approval. Acceptance: all palette commands execute correctly.

title: Add GET /health server readiness endpoint
body: Implement GET /health in apps/server that returns {status:'ready', db:'connected', uptime: seconds}. The Electron main process must poll this before showing the BrowserWindow. Without it, the webview loads before the WS server is accepting connections. Acceptance: endpoint returns 200 JSON, Electron main process waits for 200 before creating BrowserWindow.

title: Configure dev environment orchestration for all three apps
body: Running apps/web + apps/server + apps/desktop concurrently in dev mode requires coordination. Add a root-level 'dev' npm script using concurrently (or turborepo dev pipeline) that starts: apps/server (tsx watch), apps/web (vite), and optionally apps/desktop (electron with dev server URL). Server must start before web reports ready. Acceptance: 'npm run dev' from root starts all three with correct port assignments.

title: Implement environment configuration management
body: Create apps/server/src/config.ts loading config from: environment variables, a .env file (dev), and sensible defaults. Config shape: { port: number, dbPath: string, env: 'development'|'production', agentBinaryPath: string, corsOrigins: string[] }. Expose typed config singleton. Electron injects env vars when spawning the server process. Acceptance: server reads config from env, defaults work for dev.

title: Create DataFacade hooks for mock-to-real migration
body: Create a set of hooks in apps/web/src/hooks/data/ that abstract data source: useMissions(), useMission(id), useAgentSessions(missionId), useEvidence(missionId). Initially delegate to the static data/*.ts mock files. Gradually swap backing implementation to Zustand store / TanStack Query as backend wires up. Prevents page components from needing simultaneous mock-to-real migration. Acceptance: all page components use facade hooks, mock data still works.

title: Implement graceful shutdown in apps/server
body: Handle SIGTERM and SIGINT in apps/server: close all active PTY sessions (send SIGHUP to agent processes), close all WS client connections with code 1001, flush SQLite WAL and close DB connection, then exit(0). Without this, Electron app quit orphans agent processes. Acceptance: server shuts down cleanly within 5s of SIGTERM, no orphan processes.

title: Configure CORS and WebSocket security for local server
body: apps/server must only accept connections from expected origins in dev (http://localhost:5173) and from Electron renderer in production. Configure CORS for REST endpoints. Validate WS upgrade Origin header. In production (Electron), the renderer URL is a file:// or app:// origin -- handle both. Acceptance: cross-origin requests from unexpected origins are rejected, Electron renderer can always connect.

title: Create escalations table migration
body: Create 007_escalations.sql migration. The Mission model has escalationIds[] and escalationActive fields but no table. Schema: id (text PK), mission_id (FK references missions ON DELETE CASCADE), reason, context (JSON -- what was the agent doing), status (active/resolved/dismissed), resolution (text), raised_at, resolved_at, raised_by, resolved_by. Acceptance: migration runs, escalations are queryable by mission_id.

title: Create token_costs table migration
body: Create 008_token_costs.sql migration. Schema: id (text PK), agent_session_id (FK references agent_sessions ON DELETE CASCADE), model (text), input_tokens (integer), output_tokens (integer), cost_usd (real), recorded_at (timestamp). Index on agent_session_id. Acceptance: migration runs, costs queryable by session and by date range.

title: Create artifacts table migration
body: Create 009_artifacts.sql migration matching the frontend Artifact type (data/artifacts.ts). Schema: id (text PK), mission_id (FK references missions ON DELETE CASCADE), type (text -- test-report/screenshot/log/deployment/diagram), title (text), content (text -- URL or inline), thumbnail (text), created_at. Index on mission_id. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Add indexes and FK constraints to all migrations
body: Review all migration files and add: (1) missing FOREIGN KEY constraints with ON DELETE CASCADE or RESTRICT as appropriate, (2) indexes for all FK columns that will be used in WHERE clauses (agent_sessions.mission_id, evidence.mission_id, approvals.agent_session_id, mission_events.mission_id, token_costs.agent_session_id, artifacts.mission_id), (3) compound indexes where needed (mission_events: mission_id + occurred_at). Acceptance: dep-check passes, EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows index usage for common queries.

title: Add sequence numbers and heartbeat to WS protocol
body: Update packages/transport/src/protocol.ts: (1) Add seq: number field to all push events for ordering guarantees -- server increments a per-channel counter. (2) Add ping/pong heartbeat message types (30s interval, 10s timeout). (3) Add a type discriminator at envelope level: { type: string, seq?: number, payload: unknown } so messages can be routed without full Zod parsing. Acceptance: all push events carry seq, WS drops detected within 40s.

title: Implement WS replay-from-seq on reconnect
body: When a WS client reconnects, it sends { type: 'replay-from', channel: string, fromSeq: number }. The server replays any buffered events for that channel with seq > fromSeq (from an in-memory ring buffer, not DB). Prevents missed events during brief disconnects. Ring buffer size: 100 events per channel. Acceptance: client that disconnects for <30s receives missed events on reconnect.

title: Add scroll-pinning to AgentChatPanel
body: AgentChatPanel must pin scroll to bottom during streaming, break out when user manually scrolls up, and show a 'New messages' pill when new messages arrive while scrolled up. Clicking the pill re-pins. This prevents the jarring behavior where streaming output scrolls past the user's reading position. Acceptance: scroll-pinning works during streaming, manual scroll-up pauses it, pill appears and re-pins correctly.

title: Add skeleton loading states to all async-loaded panels
body: When pages load async data (TanStack Query initial fetch or Zustand hydrating), show skeleton placeholders instead of empty panels or flash-of-empty-state. Panels that need skeletons: MissionHome cards (MissionCard grid), EvidenceRail items, AgentSwimlane, DiffViewer content, CostDashboard charts, History log entries, MissionDetail metadata. Use the existing aw-skeleton CSS class (shimmer animation). Acceptance: no panel shows empty/null before data loads.

title: Create generic in-chat ApprovalCard for tool-level approvals
body: Create apps/web/src/components/execute/ApprovalCard.tsx for tool-level agent approval requests surfaced in AgentChatPanel (e.g. 'Agent wants to run: rm -rf node_modules'). Distinct from ChatPlanProposal (plan approval) and ApprovalBar (mission-level). Should show: action type, exact command/parameters, risk level (aw.accent warning tint for destructive), approve/reject buttons wired to WS approval response handler. Matches mission-control's CornerBracket + aw.* design language. Acceptance: component renders all tool-approval types, buttons dispatch correct WS messages.

title: Add WS-specific reconnection UX distinct from network offline
body: ConnectionStatusBanner handles browser online/offline. Add a separate WS reconnection state: when WS disconnects (server restart, timeout) but browser is online, show a distinct 'Reconnecting to mission server... (attempt 3/6)' banner with retry countdown using aw-pulse-accent animation. Different from the network offline message. Acceptance: WS disconnect shows reconnection banner, network offline shows different banner, successful reconnect shows brief 'Reconnected' confirmation.

title: Handle streaming interruption UX in AgentChatPanel
body: If WS drops mid-stream in AgentChatPanel, the StreamingMessage will freeze with a partial message and stuck blinking cursor. Add an interrupted state: replace blinking cursor with a warning icon (aw.accentStrong colored), append '-- connection lost' to the partial message, show a retry/resume affordance. On reconnect, resume streaming from last position if server supports replay. Acceptance: mid-stream disconnect shows interrupted state, not frozen cursor.

title: Add DiffViewer theme override for aw.* design tokens
body: @pierre/diffs uses CSS variables (--bg-secondary, --text-high, etc). Create a theme adapter in apps/web/src/components/review/DiffViewerTheme.ts that maps aw.* palette to @pierre/diffs CSS variables: addition backgrounds to semantic.successSoft, deletion to semantic.errorSoft, gutter text to aw.textSoft, line text to aw.text, container background to aw.plateDark. Inject overrides via a scoped wrapper div. Test that CornerBracket overlays don't z-index conflict. Acceptance: diff viewer matches mission-control's visual language.

title: Wire xterm.js ResizeObserver and fit() addon
body: xterm.js requires explicit fit() calls when its container resizes or it will show blank space or overflow. In TerminalSessionPane (and wherever xterm is rendered), wire a ResizeObserver to the container div that calls terminal.fit() on every size change. Also handle initial render fit() after mount. Use xterm-addon-fit. Acceptance: terminal correctly fills its container on panel resize, no blank space or overflow.

title: Add per-panel error boundaries to execute and review pages
body: MissionExecute and MissionReview contain multiple async panels (chat, terminal, diff, evidence). A single panel failure should not crash the entire page. Wrap each major panel in its own ErrorBoundary: AgentChatPanel, TerminalSessionPane, BrowserSessionPane, DiffViewer, EvidenceRail. Each boundary shows a panel-level error state with retry action using aw.* design tokens. Acceptance: throwing in one panel shows isolated error, other panels continue working.

title: Add route-level lazy loading for heavy pages
body: MissionReview (imports DiffViewer + @pierre/diffs) and MissionExecute (imports xterm.js) are heavy pages. Convert to React.lazy() in App.tsx router to code-split these chunks: const MissionReview = lazy(() => import('./pages/MissionReview')); const MissionExecute = lazy(() => import('./pages/MissionExecute')); Wrap in Suspense with skeleton fallback. Acceptance: initial bundle does not include xterm.js or diff libraries, they load on first navigation to those pages.

title: Define AgentExecutor interface for multi-agent support
body: Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentExecutor.ts defining an interface (or abstract class) for agent executors. Methods: spawn(sessionId, workingDir, options): Promise<SpawnedAgent>, spawnFollowUp(sessionId, message): Promise<void>, spawnReview(sessionId, context): Promise<SpawnedAgent>, discoverCapabilities(): AgentCapabilities, getAvailability(): AvailabilityInfo. Types: SpawnedAgent (pid, kill(), onOutput, onExit), AgentCapabilities (supportsSessionFork, supportsReview), AvailabilityInfo (available, reason). Implement ClaudeCodeExecutor first. Acceptance: interface defined, ClaudeCodeExecutor stub implements it.

title: Add ContextUsageGauge component to AgentSwimlane
body: Create apps/web/src/components/execute/ContextUsageGauge.tsx. Shows agent context window usage as a progress bar (e.g. '42k / 200k tokens'). Styled with aw.* tokens: low usage green (semantic.success), mid usage amber, high usage red (semantic.error). Parse context usage from agent output stream -- Claude outputs token counts. Display in AgentSwimlane alongside agent status. Critical for operator oversight -- operators need to know when agents approach context limits. Acceptance: gauge renders with real token counts from agent output.

title: Add optimistic update rollback UX for approval actions
body: When MissionReview approve/reject actions fail server-side after optimistic UI update, TanStack Query's onError should roll back the Zustand state and show an error toast via ToastContainer. Define a standard pattern: (1) optimistic update in Zustand, (2) server call, (3) on error: rollback + toast, (4) on success: confirm. Apply this pattern to all approval/stage-transition actions. Acceptance: simulated server failure rolls back UI state and shows error toast.

title: Add approval request notification badge and banner
body: When an agent emits an approval request during execution, the operator needs to know even if they're not watching the chat panel. Add: (1) a persistent notification badge on the mission's nav item in LeftNav showing pending approval count, (2) a banner in MissionExecute header 'Agent awaiting approval' with direct link to the approval card. Cleared when approval is resolved. Acceptance: approval request is visible outside the chat panel, badge shows count, resolves on decision.

title: Move computeVerificationState out of mock data into utility module
body: apps/web/src/data/missions.ts contains computeVerificationState() which is real domain logic, not mock data. Move it to apps/web/src/lib/verificationState.ts (or packages/shared if it has no React deps). Update all imports. This prevents it from being accidentally deleted when mock data files are cleaned up. Acceptance: function lives in a utility module, all existing callers updated, tests pass.

title: Migrate data/*.ts mock files to __fixtures__ for test use only
body: apps/web/src/data/ contains 7+ mock data files (missions.ts, agent-sessions.ts, agent-chat.ts, evidence.ts, artifacts.ts, workflows.ts, etc). Once Zustand stores and DataFacade hooks replace them as the live data source, these files should move to apps/web/src/__fixtures__/ and be imported only by test files. This cleanup prevents ghost bugs from stale mock data being accidentally used. Depends on all DataFacade hooks being complete. Acceptance: no production component imports from data/*.ts, mock files exist in __fixtures__.

title: Enable SQLite WAL mode and configure pragmas on startup
body: apps/server database initialization must run: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000; before any other queries. WAL mode is critical for concurrent reads during WS event writes. foreign_keys=ON enforces all FK constraints. busy_timeout prevents immediate failure on write contention. Acceptance: all three pragmas confirmed active on server start via PRAGMA queries.

title: Separate SQLite database for terminal session logs
body: PTY terminal output will generate high-volume writes. Storing it in the same SQLite DB as missions will bloat the WAL and slow checkpoint operations. Create a separate terminal.db file for terminal session logs (apps/server/src/db/terminal-database.ts). The main DB only stores terminal session metadata (session ID, mission ID, created_at, status). Acceptance: terminal output writes to terminal.db, mission queries unaffected by terminal write load.

title: Timebox and define deliverable for bead-0044 (Claude Code CLI research)
body: bead-0044 is a research spike with no defined scope. Add explicit timebox: maximum 2 days. Required deliverable: docs/research/claude-code-protocol.md documenting (1) exact spawn command and flags, (2) stdout/stderr format (JSON-lines? human-readable?), (3) stdin protocol for sending follow-up messages, (4) permission prompt patterns for approval gate parsing, (5) SIGTERM/SIGINT behavior, (6) session resumption capability. If CLI is unsuitable, document MCP server approach as fallback. This ticket tracks the meta-constraint, not the research itself.

title: Define v1 scope boundary and defer post-v1 tickets
body: Formally mark post-v1 tickets as deferred. v1 definition: user can create mission, spawn Claude agent, see streaming output, approve/reject agent actions, see code diff, approve/reject mission. Post-v1 scope: bead-0062 (CI ingestion), 0065/0068/0071 (cost tracking), 0074/0077 (workflow automation), 0079/0082/0084/0086/0088 (release polish beyond macOS), 0091/0092 (keybindings polish, browser screenshots), 0085/0087 (history page). This ticket tracks adding defer labels/notes to those tickets. Acceptance: deferred tickets clearly marked with v2 label.
